rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that Cardoso and Maciel were re-elected in the first round on 4 October 1998; the reproduced TSE diploma says the will of the people was expressed at the polls on 4 October 1998 and that Cardoso was re-elected President of the Republic.

locator.section: Summary and opening declaration by Antonio Carlos Magalhães; diploma on pdf p. 4 (printed 00004)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The record reproduces the Superior Electoral Court diploma, dated Brasília 12 December 1998, stating that Fernando Henrique Cardoso was re-elected President of the Republic and qualifying him for a new investiture in the office before the National Congress on 1 January 1999; the opening and the termo date the diplomação to 12 December 1998.

locator.section: Facsimile of the TSE diploma ("Brasília, aos 12 de dezembro de 1998"); opening on pdf p. 3; termo on pdf p. 6

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 1 January 1999 (opened 17:00), invited by the Congress President Antonio Carlos Magalhães, Cardoso stood and recited the constitutional commitment, followed by the Vice-President.

locator.section: Left column: invitation and "O SR. FERNANDO HENRIQUE CARDOSO - Prometo manter, defender e cumprir a Constituição..."

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After the termo was signed, Antonio Carlos Magalhães declared Fernando Henrique Cardoso and Marco Antonio de Oliveira Maciel empossados as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil for the period 1 January 1999 to 31 December 2002; the session was opened to give posse to the two, diplomados "for the period beginning on this date".

locator.section: Left column: "Declaro empossados ... para o período de 1º de janeiro de 1999 até 31 de dezembro de 2002"; opening on pdf p. 3 ("para o período a iniciar-se nesta data")

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The termo de posse records that at 17:00 on 1 January 1999, before the National Congress in joint session, Cardoso was solemnly empossado as President of the Republic, re-elected in the first round on 4 October 1998 and diplomado by the TSE on 12 December 1998, for the period 1 January 1999 to 31 December 2002; it was signed by him, the Vice-President and the Mesa.

locator.section: Termo de posse (both columns); signatories listed on pdf p. 9

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Addressing Cardoso at the end of the session, the Congress President says he speaks at the moment in which Cardoso assumes the second mandate as President of the Republic, and refers to "the mandate that has ended" and to "this one that begins today".

locator.section: Address of Antonio Carlos Magalhães, left column ("no momento em que assume o segundo mandato"; "no mandato que se findou ... neste que hoje se inicia")

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the opening of the solemn joint session of 1 January 1999 (17:00), the Mesa composition places "o Vice-Presidente da República Marco Antonio de Oliveira Maciel" at the left of the Congress President, and the Congress President then invites the President and, after him, "o Senhor Vice-Presidente da República" to take the constitutional commitment.

locator.section: Mesa composition in italics; invitation at the head of pdf p. 6 ("Em seguida, o Senhor Vice-Presidente da República")

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that the President and the Vice-President, Fernando Henrique Cardoso and Marco Antonio de Oliveira Maciel, were re-elected in the first round on 4 October 1998; the reproduced TSE diploma says the will of the people was expressed at the polls on 4 October 1998.

locator.section: Summary and opening by Antonio Carlos Magalhães ("reeleitos em primeiro turno a 4 de outubro de 1998"); diploma on pdf p. 5; termo on pdf p. 6

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The record reproduces the Superior Electoral Court diploma, dated Brasília 12 December 1998 and signed by Minister Ilmar Galvão as President of the Court with the other ministers, stating that Marco Antônio de Oliveira Maciel was re-elected Vice-President of the Republic and qualifying him for a new investiture in the office before the National Congress on 1 January 1999; the opening and the termo date the diplomação to 12 December 1998.

locator.section: Facsimile of the Vice-President's TSE diploma ("foi reeleito Vice-Presidente da República"; "Brasília, aos 12 de dezembro de 1998")

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After Cardoso, Marco Antonio de Oliveira Maciel recited the constitutional commitment before the Congress in the solemn joint session of 1 January 1999.

locator.section: Left column: "O SR. MARCO ANTONIO DE OLIVEIRA MACIEL - Prometo manter, defender e cumprir a Constituição..."

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After the termo was signed, Antonio Carlos Magalhães declared Fernando Henrique Cardoso and Marco Antonio de Oliveira Maciel empossados as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil for the period 1 January 1999 to 31 December 2002; the session had been opened to give posse to the two, diplomados "para o período a iniciar-se nesta data".

locator.section: Left column: "Declaro empossados nos cargos de Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil ... para o período de 1º de janeiro de 1999 até 31 de dezembro de 2002"; opening on pdf p. 3

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The joint termo de posse, read by the First Secretary and reproduced in its handwritten original, records that at 17:00 on 1 January 1999, before the National Congress in joint session, Fernando Henrique Cardoso and Marco Antônio de Oliveira Maciel were solemnly empossados under article 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President respectively, re-elected in the first round on 4 October 1998 and diplomados on 12 December 1998, for the period 1 January 1999 to 31 December 2002; Maciel is listed among its signatories.

locator.section: Typed termo (both columns); handwritten original on pdf pp. 7-8; signatories on pdf p. 9 ("Assinam o termo de posse os Senhores Fernando Henrique Cardoso, Marco Antonio de Oliveira Maciel, ...")

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Opening his address after the declaration of posse, Cardoso salutes "Sr. Vice-Presidente da República, Dr. Marco Maciel".

locator.section: Left column, salutation of Cardoso's address
